About IBT Industrial Solutions

About Us

At IBT Industrial Solutions, we’re here to make your business stronger, faster, and more efficient. For over 75 years, our mission has been straightforward: to help our customers succeed—through personalized service, in-depth expertise, and an unwavering commitment to integrity.

When you work with IBT, you get more than an industrial supplier.

You get a true partner—one who understands your business, solves problems fast, and is dedicated to your long-term success.

Our Company History

Since 1949, IBT Industrial Solutions has been driven by a spirit of innovation and a passion for serving customers. What began as a small “mom and pop” operation founded by Forrest L. Cloud and Bonnie Cloud has grown into one of the nation’s leading full-service industrial distributors. 

From the beginning, Forrest and Bonnie recognized that success comes from listening to customers. They combined bearings and power transmission products under one roof—a first in the industry—and built a reputation for dependable service, knowledgeable people, and honest business practices.

Originally named Industrial Bearing and Transmission Co., IBT has grown far beyond its roots. Today, as IBT Industrial Solutions, our name reflects the broad range of products, services, and expertise we provide to keep industry moving.

IBT remains proudly family-owned, led by Jeff Cloud, third-generation President and CEO. Having worked his way up through nearly every role in the company, Jeff continues to lead with the same values his grandparents started with: integrity, hard work, and dedication to customer success.

Celebrating 75+ Years of Success

In 2019, we proudly marked our 70th anniversary—a milestone that highlighted the strength of our people, our partnerships, and our commitment to doing things the right way. To honor that occasion, IBT President and third-generation leader Jeff Cloud joined a local podcast to share the history, tradition, and values that have shaped IBT for more than seven decades.

Now, as we celebrate 75+ years in business, we’re more focused than ever on the future. We remain deeply grateful to our employees, customers, vendors, and suppliers—because IBT’s success is built on yours.

Together, we’re investing in innovation, growth, and lasting partnerships that will drive the next generation of industry forward.

“We pride ourselves on being the best-trained and hardest-working team in the industry. The experience across our organization allows IBT to meet and consistently exceed our customers’ expectations.”

Jeff Cloud - President & CEO
